source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Enter the item's description.
3. Choose the test type (Portable Appliance, Combination of Appliances or Installation).
4. Select the action taken (Failed / Passed / Serviceable).
5. Select the items' defect(s) applicable to the failed appliance.
6. Comment on the defect or add additional information.
7. Input the date and time, if required (Default DD/MM/YYY).
8. Press 'Print' button - the records will be downloaded to your device and can be printed.
9. Save the test records if you wish to keep a record of the report.
